name: accessibility-audit
description: Audit UI code for WCAG 2.1 AA compliance — color contrast, keyboard navigation, ARIA roles, focus management, and screen reader compatibility. Use when the user asks to "check accessibility", "make this accessible", "WCAG audit", "a11y review", or before marking any public-facing UI as done. Do NOT use for quick pre-delivery checks — use output-enforcement for that. This skill goes deeper: it covers ARIA semantics, focus order, and live regions.
